name: cycle2-origin-reservation-audit-20260929
purpose: Bounded primary-source metadata audit, explicit reservation shortfalls and append-only identity evidence. No model results/leaderboard rankings are selection inputs.

selection_policy.ordering: ASCII canonical family_id ascending within each stratum, on the completely audited eligible pool only.

limits.evaluation_requirement: IID suitability explicitly reviewed; any eventual whole-cohort IID3 override requires a new freeze. Original official source policies/dimensions stay unchanged.

selection_policy.excluded: Prior origins/aliases/mirrors, simulation/synthetic primary fill, image-only/toy/homogeneous pixel panels, incomplete primary rights or schemas, unresolved entity/time boundaries.

decisions.name: Breast Cancer
decisions.reason: Rights and min-class85 are known, but inspected original/OpenML metadata does not establish absence of repeated patient/episode records. Do not silently call case records patient-independent IID.

decisions.name: Thyroid Disease
decisions.reason: Ten overlapping Garvan databases and multiple target/label variants require exact endpoint, target-related feature and patient-episode mapping. Do not fill a binary slot from a generic thyroid name.

decisions.name: Ozone Level Detection
decisions.reason: Daily ozone/weather records from a regional multi-year time series; IID independence is not established by treating timestamps as ordinary rows.

decisions.name: Cardiotocography
decisions.reason: Expert-labeled cardiotocograms are examination records; repeated-patient/trace identities are not established. A patient-level or approved grouped protocol needs further evidence.

decisions.name: Turkiye Student Evaluation
decisions.reason: API has no reviewed target/normalized CSV and students evaluate multiple courses/instructors. Do not invent an endpoint or pretend evaluations are independent students.

decisions.name: ser Knowledge Modeling Data (Students' Knowledge Levels on DC Electrical Machines)
decisions.reason: No normalized source URL or valid named variable/target schema; authoritative minimum-class support not established in this pass.

decisions.name: Geographical Origin of Music
decisions.reason: Multiple music recordings by geography with unresolved artist/recording grouping and absent normalized schema. No independent recording assumption.

decisions.name: Occupancy Detection
decisions.reason: Minute-level occupancy measurements and time-stamped ground truth from repeated room monitoring require temporal boundaries, not IID rows.

decisions.name: Facebook Metrics

metadata_profile.basis: Official metadata/descriptive class-count tables only; not actual payload validation.

decisions.canonical_origin: Original Moro/Rita/Vala 2014 cosmetics-brand Facebook post collection, not Mashable news or Thai sellers.

rights.approval_basis: Original UCI publication explicitly grants CC-BY-4.0. OpenML badges are not used as a blanket data-use permission.
rights.scope: Metadata-only reservation now. Later local research only after explicit freeze/release; no hosted row sharing, reidentification, clinical/admissions/individual high-stakes deployment or additional redistribution approval.
rights.obligations: Retain source/contributor attribution and disclose sampling, timing, quantification, annotation and single-cohort limits.

iid_suitability.observation_unit_basis: Primary metadata identifies rows as distinct posts from one known cosmetics page during2014. IID here is explicitly within that fixed page/year post-record population, conditional on the supplied calendar attributes; not independent brands, unseen pages or forward-time generalization.
iid_suitability.target_timing: All eleven other post-impact/engagement columns are excluded, including comment/like/share components of the target. No precise cumulative-observation horizon is invented.
iid_suitability.not_claimed: Unseen subjects/entities beyond the declared row unit, future-period transfer, causal effects or individual deployment.

decisions.name: Cervical Cancer (Risk Factors)
decisions.reason: Primary API has no explicit target; multiple examination/diagnostic outcomes need reviewed exclusion and an independently verified >=60 minority count.

decisions.name: gene expression cancer RNA-Seq
decisions.reason: 20531 predictors exceed the200-predictor ceiling.

decisions.name: Daily Demand Forecasting Orders
decisions.reason: Only60 observations, below200; daily company demand is also a time series.

decisions.name: Ultrasonic flowmeter diagnostics
decisions.reason: Repeated diagnostics of four flowmeters; no complete named schema/independent-unit protocol was established.

decisions.name: Residential Building
decisions.reason: Residential project records have unreviewed V1-V8 financial variables, economic lag alignment and output mappings. Completed-project timing/leakage exclusions cannot be guessed from anonymous column names.

decisions.name: Absenteeism at work
decisions.reason: Worker IDs recur over2007-2010. Requires grouped/time-aware handling; cannot fill primary IID quota.

decisions.name: Facebook Live Sellers in Thailand
decisions.reason: Repeated posts from10sellers and no declared supervised target in primary API. No label guessed or independent-seller claim.

decisions.name: Estimation of Obesity Levels Based On Eating Habits and Physical Condition
decisions.reason: Primary source says77% of rows were generated with SMOTE. No synthetic majority or unverified original-row subset is allowed to fill observational quota.

decisions.name: Apartment for Rent Classified
decisions.reason: API declares no target; raw price/price_display/text/ID semantics and duplicate-apartment/time boundaries require a reviewed representation. No target-role or independence invention.

decisions.name: Iranian Churn
decisions.reason: Primary random-customer sampling and explicit9-month features/12-month label timing are clear, but an authoritative >=60 minimum-class count was not verified without payloads. Remains a promising pending source, not eligible by assumption.

decisions.name: Productivity Prediction of Garment Employees

decisions.name: Synchronous Machine

decisions.name: Auction Verification

decisions.name: Steel Industry Energy Consumption

ledger.query: SELECT family_id,run_id,role,created_at FROM exposure ORDER BY family_id,run_id

exposure_audit.completed_cohort_policy: All prior registry/INRIA/UCI origins and all live-ledger admissions are excluded, including the earlier12-family and10-family confirmations. Historical registry records remain immutable; current exposure is evidenced by the live ledger, not rewritten as fresh.
exposure_audit.unknown_exposure_policy: New records keep prior_exposure=unknown, inventory role and ACTIVE reservation. No automatic audited_unexposed certification or release.

identity_notes.clinical_cancer_sources: The new differentiated thyroid recurrence cohort is not the previously used heart/renal/Wisconsin/MI cohorts. Ljubljana was NOT cleared solely from a different name; its missing entity-boundary evidence remains pending.
identity_notes.academic: Assam medical entrance candidates in one exam/year are a distinct collection from Portuguese secondary-school grades and higher-education dropout records. The ambiguous time column is removed.
identity_notes.drug_survey: One respondent cohort underlies all19 reported substance fields; reserve only the original seven-class cannabis endpoint and exclude all other outcomes/id. Do not count drug-specific targets as new families.
identity_notes.social_media: The original cosmetics-page post collection is not Mashable OnlineNewsPopularity, synthetic ecommerce examples or the10-Thai-seller repeated-post dataset.

specific_rights_hold.decision: Pending intended-use NonCommercial compatibility; do not assume the default UCI grant or waive NC because processing is local.

prior_top_level.name: benchmark-family-exposure-registry-v1
prior_top_level.policy: One runnable variant per family in each suite. Metadata inspection is not an unexposed-family audit. Unresolved origins remain separate provisional identities, never fresh confirmation.

current_exposure_snapshot.policy: Current exposure overrides historical declarations. Active candidate reservations prohibit acquisition until explicit parent release; historical manifests remain unchanged.
